about: Simulated communities with a known truth. Each strategy sees only what was readable four fifths of the way through and is judged on the first five films it offers each person. This tests mechanics and robustness, not real people.

columns.yield: films in the first five the person would have liked, averaged over everyone
columns.finds: liked films in the first five that are not among the most written-about twentieth
columns.personal: yield minus the yield of giving each person somebody else's list
columns.liked: share of offered films the person would have liked
columns.voices: different people leading the first five
columns.crowded: share of places taken by the most written-about twentieth of films
columns.range: share of the shelf offered to anyone
